name: Tripping Staff
prerequisites: Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Trip, Weapon Focus (quarterstaff), base attack bonus +6
benefit: You treat quarterstaves as if they had the trip special feature.
special:
If you are a magus with the staff magus archetype, you can use spellstrike on any trip combat maneuver you make with the staff. 
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 134
You can select this feat even if you don’t meet the ability score prerequisite (Intelligence 13). You gain the benefits of this feat only as long as you have at least 1 stamina point in your stamina pool.
